summaries.senate: The Democrats' chances of winning control of the Senate rose sharply in Polymarket odds over the past day. In [[Kansas]], the Democrat Adam Hamilton gained ground by a sharp margin, and the market treats the seat as a predicted flip. In [[Iowa]], the Republican Ashley Hinson saw a sharp drop in their chances, while in [[South Carolina]] the Republican Darline Graham Nordone slipped by a sizable amount.
summaries.governor: The Republican candidate's chances took a sizable drop in the Polymarket odds for [[Kansas]], where Ty Masterson is the leader and the market sees a predicted flip. Another sizable fall came in [[Texas]], where Greg Abbott's chances declined against the Democrat Gina Hinojosa. In [[Vermont]], the market also showed a sizable decline for the Republican Phil Scott.
summaries.house: Polymarket odds for Democratic control of the House edged up slightly, with Democrats still the favoured party. The biggest move came in [[NY-17 (Spring Valley & Ossining)]], where the Democrat Cait Conley saw a sharp drop in their chances against the Republican Mike Lawler, and the market sees it as a predicted flip. In [[NC-13 (Fuquay-Varina & Sanford)]], the Republican Brad Knott gained ground sharply against the Democrat Paul Barringer, while the Republican French Hill in [[AR-02 (Little Rock & Conway)]] slipped by a sizable margin.
